# Snake: eat the red squares, without hitting the walls or the tail.
#
# Touch the screen on the side you want to turn to: if the snake goes right or
# left, touch above or below the head; if it goes up or down, touch to the
# right or left. Touch to start and to play again after a crash.
#
# Each segment is a small LVGL object with a shared style; at every step the
# tail object moves to the new head, so the cost does not grow with the
# length. Objects are created only when needed.
import urandom as random

W = H = TOP = CELL = COLS = ROWS = SEG = HEAD = EYE = PUPIL = 0
UNIT = 1                       # 1/240 of the short side: everything scales with the screen


def px_(n):
    return int(n * UNIT + 0.5)


START_MS, MIN_MS = 220, 90     # step period: from START_MS down to MIN_MS
CRASH_MS = 600

pool = []                      # segment objects, reused between games
body_style = None
head_obj = None
eyes = []
pupils = []
food = None
point = None
X0 = Y0 = 0                    # origin of the field on the screen
state = "idle"                 # "idle", "run", "over"
body = []                      # body[0] is the tail, body[-1] the head
segs = []                      # segs[k] is the object drawn at body[k]
occupied = set()
direction = (1, 0)
turns = []                     # touches not applied yet, at most 2
food_cell = None
score = 0
best = 0
period = START_MS
elapsed = 0
crash_left = 0


def layout():
    global W, H, UNIT, TOP, CELL, COLS, ROWS, SEG, HEAD, EYE, PUPIL
    display = lv.display_get_default()
    W, H = display.get_horizontal_resolution(), display.get_vertical_resolution()
    UNIT = min(W, H) / 240
    TOP = px_(18)              # score bar
    CELL = px_(14)
    COLS = W // CELL
    ROWS = (H - TOP) // CELL
    SEG = CELL - px_(2)        # one segment, with a gap around it
    HEAD = CELL + px_(2)       # the head is a little larger than a cell
    EYE, PUPIL = CELL // 3, CELL // 6
    ui.background.set_size(W, H)
    ui.score_label.set_pos(px_(6), px_(1))
    ui.score_label.set_size(W - px_(12), TOP - px_(1))
    ui.field.set_pos((W - COLS * CELL) // 2, TOP)
    ui.field.set_size(COLS * CELL, ROWS * CELL)
    ui.message.set_pos(px_(6), (H - px_(70)) // 2)
    ui.message.set_size(W - px_(12), px_(70))
    if W < 400:
        ui.score_label.set_style_text_font(lv.font_montserrat_14, lv.PART.MAIN)
        ui.message.set_style_text_font(lv.font_montserrat_16, lv.PART.MAIN)


def show_score():
    ui.score_label.set_text("Score %d   Best %d" % (score, best))


def show_msg(text):
    ui.message.set_text(text)
    ui.message.remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN)


def disc(parent, size, color):
    o = lv.obj(parent)
    o.remove_style_all()
    o.set_size(size, size)
    o.set_style_bg_color(lv.color_hex(color), lv.PART.MAIN)
    o.set_style_bg_opa(lv.OPA.COVER, lv.PART.MAIN)
    o.set_style_radius(lv.RADIUS_CIRCLE, lv.PART.MAIN)
    o.remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.CLICKABLE)
    return o


def segment(i):
    while len(pool) <= i:
        s = lv.obj(ui.field)
        s.remove_style_all()
        s.add_style(body_style, lv.PART.MAIN)
        s.set_size(SEG, SEG)
        s.remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.CLICKABLE)
        pool.append(s)
    return pool[i]


def place(obj, cell):
    obj.set_pos(cell[0] * CELL + (CELL - SEG) // 2, cell[1] * CELL + (CELL - SEG) // 2)


def place_head(cell, d):
    head_obj.set_pos(cell[0] * CELL - (HEAD - CELL) // 2, cell[1] * CELL - (HEAD - CELL) // 2)
    head_obj.move_foreground()
    c = HEAD // 2
    side_x, side_y = -d[1], d[0]  # perpendicular to the direction
    for k, side in enumerate((-1, 1)):
        ex = c + d[0] * (CELL // 6) + side * side_x * (CELL // 4) - EYE // 2
        ey = c + d[1] * (CELL // 6) + side * side_y * (CELL // 4) - EYE // 2
        eyes[k].set_pos(ex, ey)
        m = (EYE - PUPIL) // 2    # the pupil looks ahead
        pupils[k].set_pos(m + d[0] * m, m + d[1] * m)


def new_food():
    global food_cell
    free = [(x, y) for x in range(COLS) for y in range(ROWS) if (x, y) not in occupied]
    if not free:
        return False
    food_cell = free[random.randrange(len(free))]
    place(food, food_cell)
    return True


def new_game():
    global state, body, segs, direction, score, period, elapsed
    for s in pool:
        s.add_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN)
    y = ROWS // 2
    body = [(2, y), (3, y), (4, y)]
    segs = [segment(k) for k in range(3)]
    occupied.clear()
    for c, s in zip(body, segs):
        occupied.add(c)
        place(s, c)
        s.remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN)
    direction = (1, 0)
    turns.clear()
    food.remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN)
    head_obj.remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN)
    place_head(body[-1], direction)
    score, period, elapsed = 0, START_MS, 0
    new_food()
    show_score()
    ui.message.add_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN)
    state = "run"


def crash():
    global state, best, crash_left
    state = "over"
    crash_left = CRASH_MS
    best = max(best, score)
    show_score()
    show_msg("Game over\nScore %d\nTap to play" % score)


def step():
    global direction, score, period
    if turns:
        direction = turns.pop(0)
    hx, hy = body[-1]
    head = (hx + direction[0], hy + direction[1])
    eat = head == food_cell
    if not (0 <= head[0] < COLS and 0 <= head[1] < ROWS) or (head in occupied and (eat or head != body[0])):
        crash()
        return
    if eat:
        s = segment(len(segs))     # it grows: a new object for the head
        s.remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN)
        score += 1
        period = max(MIN_MS, START_MS - 8 * score)
        show_score()
        ui.buzzer1.tone(880)
    else:
        occupied.discard(body.pop(0))  # it moves: the tail becomes the head
        s = segs.pop(0)
        ui.buzzer1.off()
    body.append(head)
    segs.append(s)
    occupied.add(head)
    place(s, head)
    place_head(head, direction)
    if eat and not new_food():
        crash()                    # field full: you won


def on_tick():
    global elapsed, crash_left
    if state == "over":
        if crash_left > 0:         # broken siren falling from 1000 to 200 Hz
            crash_left = max(0, crash_left - 20)
            if crash_left and (crash_left // 60) % 2:
                ui.buzzer1.tone(200 + 800 * crash_left // CRASH_MS)
            else:
                ui.buzzer1.off()
        return
    if state != "run":
        return
    elapsed += 20
    if elapsed >= period:
        elapsed = 0
        step()


def on_press(e):
    if state != "run":
        if state == "idle" or crash_left == 0:
            new_game()
        return
    if len(turns) >= 2:
        return
    lv.indev_active().get_point(point)
    hx, hy = body[-1]
    dx = point.x - (X0 + hx * CELL + CELL // 2)
    dy = point.y - (Y0 + hy * CELL + CELL // 2)
    cur = turns[-1] if turns else direction
    if cur[0]:                     # going right or left: turn up or down
        turns.append((0, 1 if dy > 0 else -1))
    else:                          # going up or down: turn right or left
        turns.append((1 if dx > 0 else -1, 0))


def snake_init():
    global body_style, head_obj, food, point, X0, Y0, state, body, segs
    layout()
    pool.clear()               # live editing recreates the page: the old objects no longer exist
    eyes.clear()
    pupils.clear()
    state, body, segs = "idle", [], []
    scr = lv.screen_active()
    scr.remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.SCROLLABLE)
    X0, Y0 = ui.field.get_x(), ui.field.get_y()
    ui.background.remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.CLICKABLE)
    ui.background.remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.SCROLLABLE)
    ui.field.remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.CLICKABLE)
    ui.field.remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.SCROLLABLE)
    point = lv.point_t()
    body_style = lv.style_t()
    body_style.init()
    body_style.set_bg_color(lv.color_hex(0x40E040))
    body_style.set_bg_opa(lv.OPA.COVER)
    body_style.set_radius(px_(3))
    food = disc(ui.field, SEG, 0xFF4040)
    head_obj = disc(ui.field, HEAD, 0x80FF60)
    head_obj.set_style_border_width(px_(1), lv.PART.MAIN)
    head_obj.set_style_border_color(lv.color_hex(0x208020), lv.PART.MAIN)
    for _ in range(2):
        eye = disc(head_obj, EYE, 0xFFFFFF)
        eyes.append(eye)
        pupils.append(disc(eye, PUPIL, 0x000000))
    food.add_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN)
    head_obj.add_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN)
    show_score()
    show_msg("Snake\nTap to start")
    scr.add_event_cb(on_press, lv.EVENT.PRESSED, None)
